meta_description: Claverham Tree Services in Bristol offers expert tree surgery, felling, and crown reduction. Professional arborists serving South Gloucestershire. Call now for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: NPTC Qualified Arborists — Safety & Sustainability First
hero_subhead: From overgrown branches threatening your roof to complete felling, we handle every job safely and leave your garden immaculate.
services_heading: Tree Surgery & Arboriculture Services Across Bristol
services_subhead: We combine expert knowledge with modern equipment to keep your trees healthy, safe, and beautiful — or remove them cleanly when needed.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled removal of any tree, regardless of size or location. We dismantle large trees section by section and haul away all waste, leaving your garden clear and level.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Thinning
services.desc: Carefully reduce the height or density of your tree to restore views, increase light, and reduce storm risk. We prune to the branch collar, promoting healthy new growth.

services.title: Deadwood Removal
services.desc: Remove dead, diseased, or dangerous branches before they fall. Essential for safety and tree health, especially after storms or harsh winters.

services.title: Tree Stump Grinding
services.desc: Grind out stumps below ground level with our specialist equipment. Eliminates tripping hazards and clears space for replanting or landscaping.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Management
services.desc: Keep boundary hedges neat and healthy with annual or bi-annual cuts. We maintain shape, control growth, and clear cuttings on the day.

services.title: Arboricultural Surveys & Advice
services.desc: Professional tree assessment for health, safety, or planning purposes. Written reports, recommendations, and guidance to help you make informed decisions about your trees.

about_pullquote: Trees deserve respect, not abuse. We do the job right, every time.
about_para_1: Claverham Tree Services was founded on a simple belief: that good arboriculture should be affordable, honest, and accessible to every Bristol homeowner and business. Over nearly two decades, we've grown from a one-man operation to a respected team of NPTC-qualified arborists, completing over 2,000 jobs across South Gloucestershire and beyond. We've invested in modern equipment, proper training, and full insurance because safety and quality matter.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we're transparent about costs, and we leave every garden cleaner than we found it. We're not here to sell unnecessary work — we're here to help you understand your trees and make the right choice for your home. Whether it's a storm cleanup, a planned removal, or expert advice, you get the same honest, professional approach.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Had three massive oaks looming over the house after the storms last winter. Claverham came out, quoted fairly, and removed them all within a week. Site was spotless at the end. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Richard T.

reviews.text: Been using them for four years now. Every spring they trim our hedge, and they never cut corners. Fair prices too. The lads are friendly, professional, and always tidy up without being asked. Real craftspeople.
reviews.author: Margaret W.

reviews.text: Had a dead branch hanging over the kids' trampoline. Rang them on a Friday afternoon, they came out Saturday morning and removed it safely. Peace of mind is priceless. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David K.
